body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 0e1f3709e8aec6a74ba1828ace675060152f63cc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The test now checks both refusal paths. Operation creation refuses the taper when the machine has no guide heights. The second check creates and generates the operation with test guide heights. It then loads the machine without guide heights and checks the post refusal. The existing vertical-punch test still passes.

Local results against upstream/main `62e1d36a655a71407ff7a9980057db3c8cc8197a`:

- The trial merge is clean. This main commit is already an ancestor of the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects the changed taper test.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sodick_alc400g --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sodick_alc400g`: 5 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- This PR changes one test file. It does not change posted G-code, production safety checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No mutation runs are required for this test-only change. No golden files move.
- There are no UI changes. Screenshots are not required.
- The command gate calls `taper_door`. Posting reads the guide planes before the post engine runs. This supports the cause stated in the PR.
- All checks ran locally on Linux in debug mode. No GitHub runner was used. The full batch tier and release mode were not run.
- Issue #1856 still requires a green post-merge run on main. This review does not claim that result.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
